name: Caley: Crew Invoicing
subtitle: Day-rate invoices in minutes
promotional_text: Paint the days you worked and Caley prices them: day rates, overtime and per diems, worked out your client's way. A clean PDF invoice in minutes.
description:
Caley is invoicing built for film and TV crew.

Freelancers on set don't work nine to five. Day rates, overtime past a ten-hour day, per diems, travel days and dark days: every client has their own rules, and doing the sums by hand at the end of a job is how mistakes and late payments happen. Caley does them for you.

PAINT THE DAYS
Open the calendar and tap the dates you worked. Choose work, travel, work and travel, or dark. Add overtime hours to any day. Your bill builds as you go, priced from your client's own rates.

YOUR CLIENT'S RULES, REMEMBERED
Set each client up once: day rate, per diems, overtime tiers (for example, time and a half for the first two hours, then double) and how a travel day that is also a work day should bill. Every invoice you make for them follows the same terms.

DESCRIBE THE JOB, GET THE INVOICE
Tell the assistant what you worked, in plain words: "Invoice Brightwater Live for the awards night, Monday to Wednesday, two hours overtime on Tuesday." It drafts the invoice for you to check and edit.

SEE WHAT YOU'RE OWED
The dashboard shows what you've invoiced, what's been paid and what's outstanding, by tax year. Overdue invoices stand out. Mark invoices sent or paid with a tap.

A CLEAN INVOICE EVERY TIME
Every invoice is itemised line by line, so your client can see exactly what they're paying for. Preview it as a PDF and share it from your phone.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE ON SET
- Works offline: your latest invoices are saved on your phone for when there's no signal
- Optional Face ID lock, because invoices carry your bank details
- Duplicate last month's invoice as a starting point
- Runs on iPhone and iPad, with the invoice list and detail side by side on a bigger screen

You need a Caley account to sign in. Create one at caley.app.
